name: hitsville-ms-master-width
description: Mid/Side mastering move on the UADx Hitsville EQ Mastering — the plugin's signature 2-bus trick: tighten the LOW end toward mono in the Mid + lift presence in the center, while widening the TOP by adding air on the Side (and pulling the Side lows down so the bass stays centered). M-S mode (top section = MID, bottom = SIDE). Mid: 50 Hz Peak 2 (centered weight) + 320 Hz Dip 2 (declutter) + 2 kHz Peak 1 (presence). Side: 130 Hz Dip 2 (mono-up the bass) + 5 kHz Peak 3 + 12.5 kHz Peak 3 (air/sparkle on the sides only). Measured on watercolors bus_punchy_pre vs the same dry bus (both peak-normalized -1): per-band stereo width LOW -30.0 -> -33.1 dB (tighter, more mono bass), HIGH-MID -17.4 -> -14.3 dB and HIGH -19.8 -> -15.3 dB (WIDER top), overall correlation 0.981 -> 0.986 (still mono-safe), mono-sum loss 0.63 -> 0.80 dB.
intended_for: a stereo mix / 2-bus / master that needs mastering-grade width control: mono-solid lows + wide, airy top. The standout use of this plugin. Tonal stage only — master/limit AFTER in master-track. Verify mono compatibility with [L] measure-stereo (correlation, mono-sum loss).
plugin_build: uaudio_hitsville_eq_mastering.vst3 (UADx native — renders headless, verified. NOT the .component twin = passthrough offline. iLok-account auth, no dongle; re-verify on a new rig.)
headless_notes: M-S REQUIRES ctrl_link='Unlink' (Link mirrors the top channel onto both and defeats independent M/S control). Set mid_side='M-S'. All params are enums; the string enums (dip_pk, mid_side, link, byp, speed, filter) MUST go through this harness, not apply-vst-chain's float dict. Per-band lN_freq is the real frequency control (the global *_speed switch is inert headless). The harness does NO extra M/S narrowing here (width=1.0) — the width change is entirely the plugin's own M-S EQ.
notes: top section (l*) = MID, bottom section (r*) = SIDE when mid_side='M-S'. To narrow further, deepen r2 (Side 130 Dip) and/or pull r1 (Side 50 Dip). To widen more, raise r6/r7 (Side 5k/12.5k Peak). The Side air bands (5k/12.5k) are what open the top — the GUI 'Auto Solo' that centers a channel as you tweak does NOT apply headless, so dial by the measured per-band width.

Keep moves small — at amount 8 a single band is only ~+5 dB (Peak) / ~-3 dB (Dip), so these 1-3 settings are gentle mastering shapes. Over-widening drops mono-sum: watch [L] measure-stereo correlation (keep > ~0.5 on a master) and worst_mono_sum_loss_db.
MEASURED: this preset shifted width toward 'tight lows / wide top' WITHOUT collapsing mono (corr 0.981->0.986). That spectral redistribution of width is the point, not a big overall-width jump.
